status: Prepared for a later art pass. Do not generate more images until the owner resumes that work.
owner_direction: Chunky, human, scruffy indie pixel art. Different moods and compositions at every port. Avoid polished AI concept art and exact postcard stereotypes. Initial detailed generated harbor studies were rejected and are not used in the game.
shared_prompt: Create one actual 2D indie game harbor background, native-looking 192 by 108 pixels, enlarged with nearest-neighbor. Deliberate chunky square clusters, a small individually chosen palette, flat shadows, a little awkwardness in the buildings and spacing. Simple, readable, made by a person with limited time and good taste. No text, logos, UI, gradients, bloom, cinematic lighting, realistic texture, perfect symmetry, or excessive detail. Do not reuse a standard harbor composition. Suggest the place through a few observed details rather than landmarks and stereotypes. Keep some things plain. One small, somewhat battered working boat belongs in the scene. The following individual direction takes precedence over a generic pretty harbor.

ports.direction: An ordinary hot morning in a cramped back corner of the harbor. Three uneven ochre walls, one fading green door, a patched shade cloth. The boat is half hidden behind a much-too-long pier. Dusty coral, dull yellow, and green water. Off-center composition, no grand skyline or sunsets.

Mostly shallow water and pale sand. A pink shack is too small for its roof. One crooked palm and a long empty rope line. View from low down, with the little boat entering from the far edge. Bare, bright, slightly lazy. More empty space than buildings.

A tight view beneath a huge ugly loading crane, cropped off at the top. Brick warehouse in shadow, stacked crates at inconsistent heights, an old tug squeezed into the slip. Damp rusty reds, dark brown, dirty green. No skyline postcard.

Windy gray morning, low horizon, lots of pale sky. A small red shed alone beside a short concrete dock. Far-off snow is a few blunt shapes. One yellow buoy seems too large. Cold gray-green and a single warm red, no glowing windows.

Rain on a narrow quay. Tall timber warehouses lean together unevenly, mostly cropped, a fishing boat close to the viewer. Deep bottle green water and desaturated red wood. Distant hill barely visible through two broad bands of mist. Quiet and cramped.

A muddy river at low tide, boat resting beside exposed pilings. Broad horizontal banks, a plain brick wall and one unused winch. Tobacco brown, stale olive, gray cream. The river occupies most of the frame. No famous London buildings.

Look uphill from a tiny slipway. Uneven cream houses overlap at awkward angles, one wall painted blue, roof tiles as a few large steps. Very little visible sky. Soft warm tan and desaturated teal. An everyday laundry line rather than a landmark.

A busy small boat basin viewed nearly from above. Blunt white hulls at different angles, two worn blue bollards and a bad patch in the paving. Water is a flat deep teal, warehouses mostly out of frame. Dry noon, simple shapes, no decorative architecture tour.

A long low breakwater, sun-bleached storage sheds, one boxy watchtower far off. Almost flat composition, harsh simple cream light, chalky yellow and muted green. A dark boat tucked into one corner. Resist ancient-history landmarks.

Fishing boats pulled onto a sloping beach, with a broken line of footprints and a rough wooden workbench. Buildings are far away and barely there. Orange earth, faded blue paint, olive water. Asymmetric boats with simple hand-painted stripes, no intricate decoration.

A tiny dock at the bottom of a frame dominated by a blunt mountain silhouette. Clouds obscure part of it. One stubborn little tree, two sheds that do not match. Cold blue-green, dusty plum shadows, pale stone. The mountain must remain a crude simple shape.

A close, slightly cluttered riverside coffee loading stop. Big green hillside cuts diagonally across the frame. A small orange house sits too high on stilts, workers are only a handful of pixels. Heavy humid greens and rust red. No beach resort or monument.

The widest, flattest brown river imaginable, with one very long pier disappearing into haze. Low warehouses crowded in a strip along the bottom. A faded teal tug and scattered timber. Restrained ochre, dull cream, murky olive. Intentionally unglamorous.

Steep stacked houses as big colored rectangles, one ridiculous narrow staircase, a tiny strip of water at the bottom. Faded red, mustard, dark teal, chalk blue. Slanted and crowded, with irregular gaps. No perfect rainbow row of matching houses.

A half-empty timber dock disappearing into fog. A big dark warehouse cuts into the left edge. The boat is a small warm shape close to the viewer. Muted sage and gray, one dull orange crate. No bridge, no cable car, no postcard skyline.

An unremarkable island supply dock, a low broad hill in the distance, two palms that look different from each other. A stack of fuel drums and one blue tarp. Flat mid-afternoon light, dusty purple hill, pale green water. Practical, not a tropical holiday ad.

A neat but worn little workboat slip seen through an open shed. Strong dark beams frame one side, two low tiled roofs outside, a cheap blue bucket on the dock. Muted indigo, gray-green, warm cream. No pagoda collage, no lantern festival.

Wide muddy water and a crooked, very tall cargo derrick. Low tile roofs disappear behind cargo stacks. The boat is entering at the bottom, partly cut off. Ochre haze, dirty jade, dark red-brown. Busy shapes concentrated in one corner, the rest nearly empty.

A sudden shower on a tiny dock behind shophouses. Deep roof overhang, one green shutter hanging crooked, crates under a red tarp. The far side is mostly plants. Wet dark green, old cream plaster, a small rusty red accent. Close and humid, no sweeping city view.

A monsoon-gray anchorage with boats facing different directions. A short stone seawall in the foreground, one tired painted cabin. Lilac-gray sky, warm stone, dull green water. A few strong rain streaks, large quiet shapes. No landmark palace.

A thin whitewashed harbor wall below big bare angular hills. Almost no vegetation. Dark boat, two uneven oil drums, one pale awning. Dry putty, faded peach, muted turquoise. The hills should look roughly cut from paper, not beautifully rendered geology.

A small wooden dhow beside an old patched stone wall, bow cropped at the edge. One short pier juts out at an awkward angle. Strong dull green water, ochre stone, dark brown sail rig. Shade covers most of the scene. Keep the fort only implied.

A working inlet with rough sandstone steps and a plain little corrugated-metal shed. A large pale gum-tree shape hides much of the background. Slate blue-green water, tan rock, gray roof. The boat looks small and useful. No opera house or bridge.

A quiet mooring seen from a grassy slope, with a couple of flat green islands far away. The little boat is far off center, a worn fence in the foreground and almost nothing else. Cool green, soft cream, one dark orange hull. Breezy and sparse, not perfectly picturesque.
